requested.prompt: ONE photographic live-action commercial frame, 16:9, never a grid. Show the exterior of the SAME operating Joe's Fuel & Go convenience store whose entrance and interior are in reference image 1. View from across its modest forecourt, shoulder height 35mm lens. Preserve off-white painted brick facade, dark charcoal metal entrance frame, single right-hand glass door propped open with horizontal silver bar and small round brown Joe's decal; through the open left gap we can glimpse the warm wood coffee counter and stocked chips rack. Broaden this into a believable small convenience store: one-story white brick building, broad glass windows, discreet ice freezer to left of door, a few ordinary beverage decals and practical wall lights. A modest off-white gas canopy edge with one thin burgundy stripe enters along the upper-right edge, never blocks the storefront. A single tasteful deep-burgundy script 'Joe's' sign above the entrance, subordinate small 'FUEL & GO'. The SAME dark marine-blue older station wagon from reference2 enters the extreme right foreground facing left toward a parking bay, with just its front quarter visible, leaving the facade and doorway unobscured. Correct ordinary wagon shape, not a sports car. Early autumn morning, low warm side light, soft luminous interior, believable slightly worn asphalt and curb, quiet street and trees beyond, human-scale local business, premium restrained film photograph. No carwash visible, no neon teal road graphics, no huge empty parking lot, no miniature/dollhouse perspective. Real brick grain, glass reflections, nuanced shadows, highlight detail. This must feel like a real operating neighborhood store and the natural destination of a short drive.
